description.value: Pizzeria Mercato has been serving panned Italian-style pizzas in Invermere since 2014, with dough made fresh in-house daily by owner Todd Mitchell, who trained under world champion pizzaiolo Tony Gemignani at the International School of Pizza in San Francisco. Beyond pizza the menu spans wings, dry ribs, spaghetti, meatballs, salads, and hot Italian sandwiches, with wine and craft beer also available. A licensed summer patio, delivery through Spyce, and catering service make it a flexible and well-regarded stop in the Columbia Valley.
